sections.title: Mental model — gain that refuses poison

blocks.md: **Binary Tree Max Path Sum: answer = best THROUGH-node sum; returned gain = best DOWNWARD extension, floored at 0.**

blocks.label: LC124 flagship
blocks.py:
ans = float('-inf')
def gain(r):
    global ans
    if not r: return 0
    L = max(0, gain(r.left))            # refuse poison
    R = max(0, gain(r.right))
    ans = max(ans, r.val + L + R)       # through-path (both arms)
    return r.val + max(L, R)            # downward arm only

blocks.label: LC297 preorder + null markers
blocks.py:
def ser(r, o):
    if not r:
        o.append('#'); return
    o.append(str(r.val))
    ser(r.left, o); ser(r.right, o)

def des(tokens):
    t = tokens.pop(0)
    if t == '#': return None
    node = TreeNode(int(t))
    node.left = des(tokens); node.right = des(tokens)
    return node
